description: A meeting's active guest link, as hosts see it.

link_id.description: The public lookup id (16 base32 characters; safe in logs).

max_guests_inside.description: Most link guests admitted at once.

max_waiting.description: Most link guests waiting at once.

path.description:
The guest URL's path, `/j/<link_id>#<secret>` (the secret rides in the fragment, which
no server sees in a GET).

secret.description: The secret (base64url, 22 characters). Hosts only; never logged or stored in plain text.

valid_until.description: Redeem works until here: `hard_end_at` while the meeting is open.

title: MeetingLink
